name: Royal Court / Adventure Tea: Finger Sandwiches, Warm Scones with Clotted Cream & Éclairs
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Royal Tea Experience & Cove Café
whyItWorks: Crustless white-bread turkey, ham, egg-salad, and peeled-cucumber tea sandwiches plus plain buttermilk scones and chocolate éclairs are low-residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose chamomile, peppermint, or vanilla rooibos herbal tea (strictly skip Earl Grey / Lady Grey tea due to bergamot citrus oil), and pair scones/éclairs with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Strictly avoid Earl Grey tea (bergamot citrus oil)
Skip seeded raspberry jam on scones (use honey/butter or strawberry jelly)
